_comment: Evaluation scenarios. Each expected outcome is justified by a passage from an ingested source (`basis`), so the expectation is traceable rather than invented. Expectations were written by the software author from NHS/MedlinePlus/WHO patient information and have NOT been reviewed by a clinician; results measure software behaviour against these sourced expectations, not clinical accuracy. `answers` override the default answers used by the runner (multi-select: none, severity 3, yes/no: no, age: adult, duration: 1-3 days).
